criteria.text: Confirmed diagnosis of seizures associated with Dravet syndrome (approval criterion 3).
Patient is 2 years of age or older (approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist (approval criterion 2).
ICD-10 code is provided and written on the prescription (approval criterion 4).
Patient has undergone an echocardiogram prior to initiating therapy (approval criterion 5).
Patient has tried for at least one month and failed OR has a contraindication to TWO or more of: valproate, clobazam, topiramate, levetiracetam (approval criterion 6).
Patient does not have moderate to severe renal impairment (denial criterion 2).
Patient does not have hepatic impairment (denial criterion 3).
No concomitant use of monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) or administration within 14 days (denial criterion 4).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Fintepla (fenfluramine) Criteria. Version 1; Original 12/04/20; Approval: Pending 1/15/21; Effective: Pending 3/15/21. Source effective_date 2020-11-16 is retained from the archived stub/source metadata; PDF pending stamps are recorded here.

Encoded: approval criteria 1–6 and denial criteria 2–4. Failure to meet approval criteria is a denial. Specialist consultation, ICD-10 on the prescription, prior echocardiogram, prior therapy and safety exclusions are attestations requiring documentation verification.

Prior therapy attestation requires TWO or more of valproate, clobazam, topiramate, levetiracetam, each tried for at least one month and failed OR contraindicated. A single qualifying medication, shorter failed trial, or an unlisted medication does not satisfy this requirement.

Cautions (notes only): advise patients about decreased appetite and decreased weight; monitor somnolence and sedation and advise against driving or operating machinery; monitor suicidal behavior and ideation. Serotonin syndrome has been observed particularly with concomitant serotonergic drugs. Monitor blood pressure during treatment.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 3 months; reauthorization approval up to 12 months.
Quantity (notes only): up to 12 ml/day (maximum daily dose 26 mg); 360 ml per 30 days. max_units is null; dosing and quantity are not evaluated.
Documentation verification, cautions, ongoing monitoring, duration, reauthorization, dosing and quantity enforcement require manual review; this pack remains partial.
